description: This file defines a UI component named 'Button' using the Lightning.js framework. It sets up a component with a template that displays text based on its 'favorited' state, and includes an input handler to toggle that state when the 'enter' input is received.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: A Lightning.js component representing a button that toggles its state between favorited and unfavorited.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Initializes the component's state variables: isFavorited, favoriteText, and unfavoriteText.

methods.name: input.enter
methods.description: Handles the 'enter' input event to toggle the 'isFavorited' state.
